# Kerem Özdemir

> Sustainability and economics, Munich. Products, open-source projects, instruments, case studies, tools and economics that run in the browser, free, no account. English, Turkish and German.

Everything here is static and runs on the page; nothing is uploaded and no third party is called.

## Products (https://keremozdemir.de/products/)
- [fixtern](https://keremozdemir.de/products/fixtern/): Drop the files, say as little as you like, and get back what a consultant would produce, every figure naming the rows it came from
- [Favent](https://keremozdemir.de/products/favent/): After an event, each guest finds every photo they appear in by showing the app their face; the face is measured on their own device and never uploaded
- [Oculane](https://keremozdemir.de/products/oculane/): Watches a game's economy of coins and rewards, proposes one small fix when players start to drift away, and changes nothing until a person approves it by name
- [Stamphall](https://keremozdemir.de/products/stamphall/): A checkpoint between a company's AI assistants and its systems: every action an assistant asks for is checked first, and one no stops it
- [Sovela](https://keremozdemir.de/products/sovela/): Fall asleep to music; your Apple Watch notices you falling asleep, and Sovela pauses the music on your iPhone and dims your lights. In development, not on the App Store

## Projects (https://keremozdemir.de/projects/), open-source on GitHub, each installs from GitHub and runs
- [chess-glasses](https://keremozdemir.de/projects/chess-glasses/): A chess coach in camera glasses: it watches the board through the camera and says the best move in your ear
- [destroy-guard](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/destroy-guard): Stops an AI assistant from running a delete-everything command until a checked backup of exactly that thing exists
- [credential-reach](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/credential-reach): Shows which passwords, keys and logins on a computer an AI assistant could reach, without revealing them
- [pkg-vitals](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/pkg-vitals): Checks every package before an AI assistant installs it, against invented and abandoned names
- [mcp-upkeep](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/mcp-upkeep): Checks an add-on for an AI assistant for maintenance, licence and withdrawal before it is added
- [agent-vitals](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/agent-vitals): A dataset published every day: the AI agent repositories on GitHub, how many are maintained and how many are licensed
- [awesome-vitals](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/awesome-vitals): Finds the dead, abandoned, renamed or unlicensed repositories in any list of links
- [Agent and skill packs](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/agent-kit): Eleven packs of agents and skills for Claude Code on one shared convention
- [csrd-scope](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/csrd-scope): Whether the EU sustainability reporting law applies to a company and from which year, with the article
- [cbam-mcp](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/cbam-mcp): Whether the EU carbon border charge applies to a product, and the EU default emissions per country
- [financed-emissions](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/financed-emissions): A bank's financed emissions from its loans and investments, with the arithmetic shown
- [eudr-scope-mcp](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/eudr-scope-mcp): Whether a product falls under the EU deforestation law, from when, and the country risk
- [vsme-kit](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/vsme-kit): The EU voluntary sustainability report for small firms, and a check of a filled-in template
- [eu-taxonomy-mcp](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/eu-taxonomy-mcp): Which activities count as green under the EU taxonomy for an industry, with the test each must pass
- [eu-ets-mcp](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/eu-ets-mcp): Reported CO2 and free permits for every EU installation in the emissions trading system
- [esg-toolkit](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/esg-toolkit): Emissions decomposition, reduction pathways, abatement cost and CBAM embedded emissions
- [xlsx-review](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/xlsx-review): A formula-level diff of two Excel files that flags the edits that usually break a spreadsheet
- [analyst-toolkit](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/analyst-toolkit): Market sizing from two directions and a discounted cash flow
- [unitguard](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/unitguard): Refuses arithmetic on numbers whose units do not match
- [open-climate-data](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/open-climate-data): Provenance for every figure, and unit conversion that refuses to guess

## Games (https://keremozdemir.de/games/)
- Steal a Treasure, a Roblox game by Frons Studios

## Case studies (https://keremozdemir.de/cases/)
- [Discounted cash flow](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/dcf-lab/): A discounted cash flow where the terminal value is not allowed to hide
- [Marginal abatement cost curve](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/marginal-abatement/): An abatement cost curve that prints the arithmetic behind every bar
- [Emissions decomposition](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/carbon-bridge/): Four causes for one change in emissions, with nothing left over
- [Unit conversion](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/unitguard/): A converter that names what is missing instead of guessing it
- [Market sizing](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/market-sizer/): Two sizings and the gap between them
- [Reduction pathway](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/target-path/): A reduction target is one number
- [Data provenance](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/provenance/): A figure that carries its source and keeps carrying it through the arithmetic
- [CBAM embedded emissions](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/embedded/): A single embedded emissions figure hides the one thing an abatement decision needs

## Tools (https://keremozdemir.de/work/workshop/), 9 single-job tools, 466 hand-written checks
- [Dotsheet](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/dotsheet/): Text into Unified English Braille, and the braille back into text, so you can read what it actually says
- [Sheetwise](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/sheetwise/): Puts the pages of a PDF onto press sheets in the order a folded and stitched book needs
- [Cutplan](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/cutplan/): Turns a drawing into instructions for a laser cutter, cutting the holes before the outline so the part does not drop out first
- [Loudmeter](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/loudmeter/): Measures how loud an audio file is against the broadcast standard, and says how much to turn it up or down
- [Cutfill](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/cutfill/): How much earth has to come out and how much has to go in to bring a site to the level you want
- [Cuecheck](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/cuecheck/): Checks a subtitle file against the reading speed and timing rules a broadcaster applies
- [Boardplan](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/boardplan/): Lays parts out on sheet material in cuts a panel saw can actually make
- [Buildup](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/buildup/): The layers of a wall in, how much heat it loses out, to the standard building control asks for
- [Costcurve](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/costcurve/): Ranks emission cuts by what each one costs per tonne, and will not cut more than there is to cut

## Economics (https://keremozdemir.de/work/essays/): pieces with the model in the page, agent based simulations, six games of strategy and two research notes
- Segregation: A runnable Schelling model
- Diffusion: The same contagion at the same transmission probability, run over three network shapes: a lattice, a small world graph and a scale free graph
- Jam: A ring road with nothing blocking it
- Pile: A sandpile driven one grain at a time, organising itself to the edge of stability
- Recommender: A feed that decides what each agent sees, run again against a neutral one on the same population
- Lemons: Adverse selection, run as a used car market
- Incidence: Drag the supply and demand curves, set a tax, and watch the burden split between the two sides
- Discounting: Move the rate and watch a fixed benefit in a distant year lose almost all of its present value
- Cooperation: The repeated prisoner's dilemma

- Six games of strategy: The Long Game, The Stag Hunt, The Ultimatum, The Commons, The Beauty Contest, Matching Pennies
- Research notes: [The agent was never alone: SIMEA](https://keremozdemir.de/notes/simea/), [Determinism does not buy you a forecast](https://keremozdemir.de/notes/determinism/)

## Instruments (https://keremozdemir.de/work/instruments/)
- CBAM, embedded emissions, reduction pathways, provenance and DCF valuation, each running in the page
